acts.t: Gabriel Orozco | Chronotopic, Curated by Briony Fer
acts.q: Bringing together approximately 200 new and existing works spanning sculpture, painting, photography, assemblage and works on paper, Gabriel Orozco’s ‘Chronotopic’ is curated by art historian Briony Fer, who has written extensively on the artist.
